version.changelog:
- Added non-executable reference notes in references/api.md to support local review without scripts or automation.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify the presence of references/api.md and to remove outdated references to the deleted skill-card.md.
- Removed skill-card.md, as the documentation is now focused within SKILL.md and references/api.md.
- No changes to API logic, workflow, or security guidelines.

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only APIDot GPT Image 2 skill with no executable files or hidden automation.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to guide APIDot GPT Image 2 integrations, and the artifact contains only SKILL.md plus a non-executable reference note.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to APIDot docs, async task handling, polling, webhooks, and safe API-key handling; live API calls require explicit user request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install scripts, bundled clients, dependencies, shell commands, or executable files are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may lead an agent to use APIDot docs, APIDot APIs, GitHub examples, and an APIDOT_API_KEY, which is expected for the integration and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill itself has no persistence or privilege mechanism; it only recommends application-level storage of task IDs, statuses, media references, and final image URLs for normal async workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Installers should still treat APIDOT_API_KEY, prompts, source image URLs, callback URLs, and generated image URLs as sensitive. Use the current APIDot docs before making real API calls, and keep any API key server-side only.
